findings.issue: Production deploy runs docker system prune -af --volumes and docker image prune -af before health check succeeds
findings.impact: Previous SHA-tagged images (needed for rollback) are destroyed before the current deploy is verified. If deploy fails, there is nothing to roll back to.
findings.fix: Move docker prune steps to AFTER successful health check; or use timestamp-based pruning that preserves at least the previous release's SHA images

findings.issue: Rollback job has needs: build-images — triggers unnecessary image build before rollback can execute
findings.impact: Rollback delayed by 20+ minutes (unnecessary image build) while production is degraded
findings.fix: Change rollback job needs to [provision] only — rollback pulls existing SHA images without building new ones

findings.issue: Production version badge build-args (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME) not passed
findings.impact: Production always shows 'v0.0.0-dev' and 'local' — operators cannot identify which version is running without inspecting GHCR tags
findings.fix: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_VERSION=${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ github.run_number }}, NEXT_PUBLIC_GIT_SHA, NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME build-args to web Docker build step

findings.issue: No database down/rollback scripts exist for any of the 26 migrations
findings.impact: Forward-fix is the only path for migration issues; PITR causes data loss for the entire database
findings.fix: Write down scripts (.down.sql) for each migration, starting with the 5 ALTER TABLE migrations (#14, #15, #16) that add columns

findings.issue: No rollback job exists for development environment — always deploys latest origin/develop
findings.impact: Broken develop deploy requires manual SSH intervention; no automated recovery path
findings.fix: Add workflow_dispatch with rollback_sha input to deploy-development.yml matching production pattern

findings.issue: Feature flags exist in database but are not wired to any application code — 5 seed flags control nothing
findings.impact: In an emergency, there is no kill-switch mechanism to disable features (push notifications, realtime, file upload)
findings.fix: Audit all feature boundaries and add featureFlagService.evaluateFlag() checks; implement global kill-switch flag

findings.issue: Post-rollback validation only checks /healthz HTTP 200 — no functional smoke tests
findings.impact: Rollback can pass health check while critical features (auth, messaging, realtime) are still broken
findings.fix: Add smoke-test step after rollback: send test message via API, verify WebSocket connect, check auth flow

findings.issue: Migration rollback runbook incorrectly states PostgreSQL does not support DDL rollback
findings.impact: Operators may not attempt safe DDL rollback (BEGIN; ... ROLLBACK;) thinking it's impossible
findings.fix: Correct the runbook: PostgreSQL fully supports DDL rollback within transaction blocks

findings.issue: Development deploy runbook has no rollback section at all
findings.impact: Operators lack documented recovery steps for failed development deployments
findings.fix: Add rollback section to development-deploy-overview.md referencing the production rollback pattern

findings.issue: Circuit breaker implemented but not wired to any feature flag or kill-switch
findings.impact: Circuit breaker opens silently on external dependency failure but no kill-switch mechanism exists to manually disable the failing integration
findings.fix: Wire circuit breaker state to feature flag evaluation so operators can manually disable failing integrations

findings.issue: No git tags or semver releases — only git SHAs identify releases
findings.impact: Cannot easily reference known-good states; no release notes; git describe falls back to bare SHA
findings.fix: Add git tag (e.g., vYYYYMMDD-runNumber) at end of deploy-production.yml; create release notes

findings.issue: Rollback readiness checklists exist in docs/ but are not referenced by any workflow or runbook
findings.impact: Checklists are undiscoverable during incident response
findings.fix: Reference rollback_readiness_checklist.md from production-deploy-overview.md and incident-response.md
